answer: Each identity anchors one hardware key at enrolment, frozen ninety days; moving it voids the escrow. Rewards collect in a nectar pool that unlocks only after the answer survives three replay echoes at random later slots: an independent node re-executes it and outputs must match byte for byte. A farm mints keys faster than honey dries, but echoes catch cloned outputs since re-execution exposes identical timing signatures across the fleet. One failed echo forfeits the whole pool, so fake work costs the very balance it pretends to earn.
